Subject: Hosted API pricing - follow-up: monthly token volume & peak TPS

Hi Eleanor,

Great to meet you on the call today - thanks for walking through FintechCo's fraud detection flow. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together an accurate hosted pricing estimate: 

- Use case recap: real-time transaction enrichment + user risk scoring (inference-only; no user data stored by default).
- Integration: server-side calls into Redwood Hosted API, batching for low-latency scoring on high-volume windows.
- Things we need from you to finalize pricing:
  1) Expected monthly token volume (rough range is fine, e.g., 50M-200M tokens/mo)
  2) Expected peak TPS (or peak requests/minute) during campaign spikes
  3) Any target $/1M tokens or internal budget range you have in mind

Attached is our standard hosted pricing overview (redwood-hosted-pricing-v1.pdf) and a simple cost-model template we can fill with your numbers (cost-model.xlsx). If it helps, we can propose: 1) on-demand hosted rates, and 2) a discounted reserved commit for a 3mo pilot (common for customers at your scale).

Can you share the ranges above? Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up with you + Tom if you'd like to walk through the numbers. Calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/20min

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter

Ben - thanks for the recap and the materials. A few numbers from our side (estimates, happy to tighten after internal sync):

- Monthly token volume (estimate): 150M-250M tokens/mo (most activity driven by business hours in NA + occasional campaign windows)
- Peak TPS: roughly 15-20 TPS during peak batch windows (short spikes, ~5-10 minutes)
- Budget target: we were hoping for something in the $1,000-$1,500 per 1M tokens range given the expected scale; open to different commitment/discount structures

For context: we need p95 latency < 250ms for scoring endpoints; we're planning server-side batching of up to 5 requests when possible. We can share a short product spec (attached) that shows payload sizes.

Tom and I are available Tue-Thu next week if you want to run scenarios.

Cheers,
Eleanor

Thanks - this is super helpful.

Quick notes / preliminary math so we can align before a pricing call:

- Taking the midpoint of your range (200M tokens/mo) as an example:
  - If list rate = $X per 1M tokens, monthly spend = 200 * $X
  - If your target is $1,000-$1,500 per 1M, that implies monthly spend in the $200k-$300k range at pure usage pricing

- Peak TPS: 15-20 TPS is well within our hosted capacity; we typically route to lowest-latency pools and can enable burst capacity for short spikes. Autoscaling and burst are available for Dedicated/Reserved but we can support with Hosted as well (we'd instrument autoscale triggers so p95 stays <250ms).

- Unit economics and commitment options we can evaluate:
  1) On-demand hosted - simple pay-for-usage, no commit (baseline rate).
  2) Reserved commit (3mo pilot) - you commit to a monthly token floor and get an incremental discount off list; common structure is 10-25% discount depending on % commit and expected sustained usage.
  3) Enterprise reserved - multi-year/large commit with custom SLOs and lower $/1M token rates.

Next steps I propose:
- Quick pricing call (15-30m) with me + Marissa (we'll have a sample cost model filled out).
- We will populate the cost-model.xlsx with three scenarios: conservative (150M/mo), expected (200M/mo), stretch (250M/mo) and show monthly spend at on-demand vs 3mo reserved pilot pricing.

Would Tuesday 2/17 at 10am PT work for you and Tom? If not, propose alternatives and we'll send a calendar invite.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: cost-model.xlsx
